title: About

blocks.title: Built on 35+ years in the field.
blocks.text:
Neil Smith and Dennis Frederickson built Neil Smith Construction together. Neil brought decades of experience in excavation, heavy civil and agricultural work, from small backfill jobs to major highway projects with crews of fifty or more. Dennis brought decades of experience in residential and commercial construction and project management.

After Neil’s passing in 2022, Dennis took over leadership of the company and has guided it through steady growth: from utility upgrades and bulk excavation to school district programs, municipal sewer separation and specialized public facilities.

Today the company carries the standards it was founded on: quality work, delivered safely, on time and on budget.

blocks.title: Company facts.
blocks.body:
- **Name:** Neil Smith Construction Ltd. (NSC)
- **What we do:** heavy civil construction: excavation and earthworks, underground utilities and sewer separation, stormwater detention, roadworks, concrete and site servicing
- **Experience:** 35+ years in heavy civil work
- **Founders:** Neil Smith and Dennis Frederickson
- **Led by:** Dennis Frederickson, Owner, Co-Founder and Director
- **Head office:** #206-6011 Westminster Hwy, Richmond, BC V7C 4R9
- **Equipment yard:** 22617 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC V2Z 2T5
- **Service area:** Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley. See [areas we serve](areas/index.html)
- **Safety:** COR certified, BC Construction Safety Alliance
- **Markets:** municipal and public works, school districts, public facilities and institutions, private development and housing
- **Clients include:** City of Vancouver, City of Surrey, University Endowment Lands, school districts #36 Surrey, #37 Delta, #38 Richmond, #40 New Westminster and #41 Burnaby. See [all clients and partners](clients.html)
- **Contracts:** prime contractor, and civil subcontractor to construction managers and general contractors
- **Contact:** 604-644-5884 · info@nscltd.ca

blocks.title: Our values.
blocks.intro: The standards the company was founded on, and the ones every new team member is held to.

items.title: Quality
items.text: We build to a high standard, the first time, and stand behind it.

items.title: Safety
items.text: Everyone goes home safe. Safe work is efficient work.

items.title: Schedule and cost
items.text: We plan carefully and deliver on time and on budget.

items.title: Teamwork and learning
items.text: We keep learning and we work as one team, office to field.

blocks.title: The people accountable for your project.
blocks.intro: A Senior Project Manager on every project, a dedicated estimating division and superintendents with decades in the field.

blocks.title: Structured for major projects.
blocks.intro: Every job is run by a full project team, from the first estimate to the final as-built.

items.title: Estimating
items.text: A dedicated estimating division prices tenders, prequalifications and change work for municipal, school district and private clients.

items.title: Pre-construction
items.text: Traffic management plans, local bylaws and Good Neighbour programs are reviewed and in place before we mobilize.

items.title: Project management
items.text: A Senior Project Manager on every project, with a dedicated Project Manager running it day to day.

items.title: Field operations
items.text: Site superintendents and foremen lead the crews, with Trimble GPS grade control and digital reporting on site.

items.title: Quality and close-out
items.text: Coordinators manage QA/QC records, RFIs, testing and as-builts through to handover.

items.title: Safety
items.text: COR certified, with a Construction Safety Officer and a toolbox meeting at the start of every shift.

blocks.title: Across the Lower Mainland.
blocks.intro: Head office in Richmond, yard in Langley, and work from the University Endowment Lands to Chilliwack.

items.q: What is Neil Smith Construction's official website and phone number?
items.a: The official website is www.neilsmithconstruction.com and the office phone is 604-644-5884. Email info@nscltd.ca. The earlier address neilsmithconstructionltd.com now forwards to it.

items.q: Where is Neil Smith Construction based?
items.a: Our head office is at #206-6011 Westminster Hwy, Richmond, BC V7C 4R9, and our equipment yard is at 22617 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC. We work across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley.

items.q: How much experience does the company have?
items.a: Neil Smith Construction is built on more than 35 years of excavation and heavy civil experience. Neil Smith and Dennis Frederickson built the company together, and Dennis has led it since 2022.

items.q: What kind of work does Neil Smith Construction do?
items.a: Heavy civil construction: underground utilities (sanitary sewer, storm sewer and watermains), sewer separation, excavation and earthworks, stormwater detention, roadworks, curb and sidewalks, and site servicing.

items.q: Who does Neil Smith Construction work for?
items.a: Municipalities, school districts, public facilities and private developers. Clients and partners include the City of Vancouver, the City of Surrey, the University Endowment Lands, and school districts in Surrey (SD36), Delta (SD37), Richmond (SD38), New Westminster (SD40) and Burnaby (SD41).

items.q: Does NSC work as a prime contractor or a subcontractor?
items.a: Both. We take prime contracts with public owners and work as the civil subcontractor for general contractors and construction managers.

items.q: Is Neil Smith Construction COR certified?
items.a: Yes. We hold a Certificate of Recognition (COR) from the BC Construction Safety Alliance, which confirms an audited health and safety program.
